# Hostile vocabulary bundles

These exact-byte cases exercise duplicate detection, closed-schema rejection,
executable-shape rejection, raw-number rejection, malformed JSON, unknown tagged
types, target validation, embedded recursion, defaults, and required features.
Additional binary UTF-8/BOM and resource-limit vectors are generated by tests.

Strict JSON forbids inline comments; licensing for the exact `.json` bytes is
recorded here under Apache-2.0.
